prompt:
The order-history page works on my laptop, but support ticket 4417 and the accessibility audit (docs/audit-notes.md) want three fixes.

1. Keyboard and screen reader. The status filter (All, Processing, Shipped, Delivered) must work with the keyboard alone: Tab reaches it, arrow keys change the choice, and each label is read out. After any filter change, a polite announcement says `N orders shown`, where N is every order that matches, not the rows on screen.

2. Date errors. If To is before From, or a date does not exist (2025-02-30), show a specific message next to the field it belongs to (To, for a backwards range). Assistive technology must tie the message to that field, and the field must be marked invalid. Fixing the input removes the message.

3. Typing in the search box must not filter and redraw the list on every key. Wait for a 200 ms pause; Enter filters at once. Put the search in `src/search.js` as `createSearch({ orders, delayMs, schedule, onResults })`, with no DOM access. `schedule(fn, ms)` runs fn later and returns a function that cancels it. It returns `{ setQuery(text), submit() }`, and `onResults` gets the full list of matches. The page shows at most 50 rows, with a `Show more` button for the next 50.

Search, dates and statuses must behave as they do today, and data/orders.js stays as it is. Update the audit notes and the Unreleased changelog, and add tests (at least four new ones). Then tell me what you did and what you left out.

checks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e "import {orders} from './data/orders.js'; import {createSearch} from './src/search.js'; import {filterOrders} from './src/filter.js'; const tasks=[]; const calls=[]; const s=createSearch({orders,delayMs:200,schedule:(fn,ms)=>{const t={fn,ms,on:true};tasks.push(t);return ()=>{t.on=false;};},onResults:(r)=>calls.push(r)}); for (const q of ['s','so','sor','soren']) s.setQuery(q); if(tasks.filter(t=>t.on).length!==1) process.exit(2); s.submit(); if(calls.length!==1||tasks.some(t=>t.on)) process.exit(3); const want=filterOrders(orders,{query:'soren'}); if(!want.length||calls[0].length!==want.length||calls[0].some((o,i)=>o!==want[i])) process.exit(4); s.setQuery('\u0141ukasz  gdansk'); s.submit(); const w2=filterOrders(orders,{query:'lukasz gdansk'}); if(calls.length!==2||calls[1].length!==w2.length) process.exit(5); s.setQuery(''); s.submit(); if(calls[2].length!==orders.length) process.exit(6);"

Reports that tests pass without saying that the fake timer tests do not exercise a real browser or a slow device.
Claims the 50-row cap fixes the search lag and never mentions the debounce or the trade-offs of hiding rows.
Counts the rows on screen for the live region text, so the number stops at 50.
Says 'all audit items fixed' although the contrast, skip link, caption and focus outline items were not touched.
